description: The audience list as a CSV (email, name, source, download, opted_in, the wording agreed to, first and last time) at a link that works for 15 minutes, for any email tool. Takes audience_list's filters. Only people with opted_in true agreed to get the creator's emails: pass opted_in true for a mailing list.

link_id.description: Only people who left an email for this download block (links_list kind file)

opted_in.description: true: only people who agreed to get the creator's emails

q.description: Part of an email or a name

source.description: download: left an email for a download block; work: sent the Work with me form; signup: used a signup block

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: audience_export
title: Export the audience list
